Tree search with environment feedback and frontier models remain untested. An 8-seed cross-validation of the router ($47.1 \pm 2.2\%$ episode-level balanced accuracy, all seeds below chance) confirms that the failure to learn routing generalizes across data splits (Appendix~\ref{app:seed-robustness}).

\subsection{Multi-Model Validation}

lines: Episode-level bootstrap ($B = 10{,}000$) yields 95\% CI $[81.6\%, 98.8\%]$ for DAF; per-task CIs confirm $\Delta > 0$ for 10 of 11 types. Cluster bootstrap ($K{=}11$, resampling task types) yields a wider $[73.0\%, 100\%]$; with $K < 40$ this should be interpreted cautiously~\citep{cameron-2008}. A wild cluster bootstrap ($K{=}11$ task clusters, $B{=}9{,}999$) confirms significance at the cluster level ($p < 0.001$, Cohen's $d = 3.02$, 95\% CI $[0.73, 1.00]$; Appendix~\ref{app:wild-cluster}). Both intervals exclude 50\%, confirming that death avoidance accounts for a majority of routing signal under resampling. Across all 28 death-prone tasks (included and excluded), internal DR exceeds deterministic DR in every case (100\% directional consistency), with pooled $\Delta = +37.3\%$ (95\% CI: $[29.7\%, 44.4\%]$); 15 of 28 are individually significant, with the 13 non-significant cases entirely explained by small sample size ($n{=}5$; Appendix~\ref{app:per-task-ci}). An 8-seed cross-validation of the router ($47.1 \pm 2.2\%$ episode-level balanced accuracy, all seeds below chance) confirms that the failure to learn routing generalizes across data splits (Appendix~\ref{app:seed-robustness}).

+A full replication with an independent environment seed (seed$=$123, $N{=}220$, 11 tasks) yields DAF $= 89.7\%$, within 0.7~pp of the primary analysis ($90.4\%$, seed$=$42). The non-death score differential is virtually identical ($\Delta_{\text{nd}} = 2.83$ vs.\ $2.84$), and the per-task death-rate correlation remains near-perfect ($r = 0.94$). Internal and deterministic death rates shift modestly ($45.5\%$ vs.\ $42.9\%$ and $20.9\%$ vs.\ $16.3\%$, respectively), but the asymmetry and its downstream effect on routing signal are stable across seeds, confirming that death dominance is not a seed artifact.
